headline_probe_pith_ring_luminance.method: REPRODUCED from r2-cutter.json: lower watermelon half of 05-cut+500ms at 640x360 native; largest flesh blob (R>G+35, L>18) opened 5x5 and hole-filled defines the cut face; 360 rays from the flesh centroid, walk outward from the last flesh pixel, collect the non-flesh non-peel run until a peel run (G>R+8) of >=4px; mean run luminance binned into 12x30-degree sectors.

why_it_is_stuck.code_path: src/fruit/species.js:829 sets pithC = vec3(0.400,0.405,0.325) * gran * capKey(). capKey (line 226) = saturate(N.L)*1.46 + 0.30, peak 1.76, so peak pith albedo 0.704 linear; then wetFilm (line 521) adds vec3(0.200,0.200,0.196) on top of it, then x1.25 light, x1.28 toneMappingExposure (stage.js:578) into NeutralToneMapping. The model has plenty of theoretical swing (1.76/0.30 = 5.9x); the output has nowhere to put the bright half.

evidence.blind_call: Still instantly the render, but the tell has narrowed to one feature. Set the r3 lower-half crop beside the plate-02 near lemon: the lemon's peel rolls from a hot key at upper-left into unlit shadow at lower-right, never touching 255, with a hard unlit edge against the background. Ours is a near-constant cream annulus at L~240 for two thirds of its arc with a soft bloom halo bleeding onto the black. It reads as a stroke with an outer glow drawn onto a disc. Sub-second call. The upper half's wet beaded face, by contrast, would survive a glance.

fix: In src/fruit/species.js, stop the pith band saturating so capKey()'s swing has somewhere to go. Three edits, all in the watermelon cut-cap colorNode: (1) drop pithC's base from vec3(0.400,0.405,0.325) to ~vec3(0.235,0.238,0.191) and cut capKey's ambient from 0.30 to ~0.10 with gain ~1.20, targeting a key-facing pith sector of L~175 post-tonemap (the reference lemon's brightest peel sector) and a shadow sector near L~70; (2) gate the wetFilm foam additive at line 521 out of the layered zone with .mul(L.pith.oneMinus()) exactly the way sssMask already does at line 867, so the foam stops lifting the band's floor; (3) deepen the baked groove at line 818 from .mul(0.58) to ~.mul(0.85) and widen it inboard to ss(0.660,0.812,rad). Accept only when the same probe reports ZERO pith-ring pixels at R>=254 (currently 67%, reference 0.00%) and a 30-degree-sector ratio >= 1.8 (currently 1.32).
